You might have noticed that one of these AIs is not like the others. This is Z2, an AI that I built from scratch to be the most ruthless Mafia player. We'll see how she does. But before we start the game, let's review the rules real quick: there are 12 players—three Mafia and nine Town members. Every night, the Mafia picks one player to kill, the Doctor picks one player to save, and the Sheriff picks one player to investigate. The Vigilante has a gun with one shot, which they can use on someone they think is Mafia. Other players are Villagers who don't know anything. During the day, all players can vote to kill one person. The Town wins if they vote out all the Mafia; the Mafia wins if they get a majority. These are the assigned roles for the game. Mafia, choose your first target.
